_: ONE-BUNDLE SHOWCASE of the parallel-built batch — exercises several new features in a single coc. (1) Custom LIGHT (LIGT builder): an eerie green flickering light glows in the Sleeping Giant Inn. (2) Per-phase HEADTRACK: during the argument Borin turns to look straight at YOU (the player) on one line, instead of at Hilda. (3) SitTarget performance beat (re-confirmed): Borin walks across the inn and sits on a chair before the argument. All wrapped in the proven presence-gated autoStart scene with brawlOnEnd (essential NPCs => non-lethal). Test: coc RiverwoodSleepingGiantInn (save+reload on an old save), look for the green glow, then stand near both NPCs => Borin walks over + sits, they argue (watch Borin face the camera on his 2nd line), then they brawl. Also in this batch but shipped as standalone repo examples: package-activate.json (Activate template — NPC pulls a ref), package-eat.json (Eat template), lights.json, scene-headtrack.json. Bundles MFSceneBanterController.pex automatically.

packages._: SitTarget package the scene drives — Borin walks to the chair (InnChair) and sits.

quests._: Controller host quest. StartGameEnabled so MFSceneBanterController arms the presence poll.
quests.name: ModForge Showcase

scenes._phases: phase 0 = lineless BEAT (Borin walks to the chair + sits, 10s Timer). phases 1-4 = the argument; phase 2 (Borin's 2nd line) sets headtrackPlayer so he turns to face YOU.
